propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from immutable CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared kernel, respecting effective disables/retunes and project applicability.
When one criterion fails after RP-01, retain earlier successes and continue independent criteria; missing blocking-capable coverage returns INDETERMINATE unless real block exists.
Authored usd_budget must be enforced by shedding over-budget units before calls; zero budget is schema-invalid and omission leaves uncapped.
Base-reviewer summary, one-hop Round B, model-ladder resolution, sequential scheduling, and absence of code-review checkpoints must remain unchanged from pre-cutover contract.
Project DET criteria execute through detector selector outside LLM fan-in; project LLM criteria select by effective globs and execute exactly once per selected criterion.
Shadow contract tests must use one observed call set and detect no differences outside approved delta allowlist while preserving narrow, backward-compatible response and status schemas.
